method.coordinateConvention: Original PNG pixels, origin at upper left, x rightward and y downward; boxes are [left, top, right-exclusive, bottom-exclusive]. Particle centers and uncertain-stroke boxes are approximate visual localizations, not reconstructed geometry.

certaintyConvention.high: Feature and its broad location are visible; no claim of subpixel precision.
certaintyConvention.medium: A round contour or stroke is localizable, but contact or raster loss limits its identity or extent.
certaintyConvention.low: Only an arc, merged ink, or plausible round/stroke region is visible; identity, multiplicity, closure, or connectivity remains unresolved.

method.nativePixelLocalizationAid: A read-only, threshold-220 four-neighbor white-component scan supplied bounding boxes and centroids for attention to existing pixels. These are white spaces, NOT a particle count or semantic segmentation. Connected white regions cross multiple incomplete loops; small white wedges may be interstices rather than particles. No components were used to fill missing edges.
